---
title: "Operators"
---

|     |                     |     |                          |
|:---:|---------------------|:---:|--------------------------|
| \<- | Assignment Operator |     |                          |
|     | Arithmetic          |     | Relational               |
| \+  | Addition            | \<  | Less than                |
| \-  | Subtraction         | \>  | Greater than             |
| \*  | Multiplication      | ==  | Equals                   |
|  /  | Division            | \<= | Less than or equal to    |
| \^  | Exponent            | \>= | Greater than or equal to |
|     |                     | !=  | does not equal           |
